justification: Nothing changes because nothing needs to change — Burrow's my guy after dropping 462 and five, Chase is the best receiver in this league and I don't care who's second, and Hubbard stays in the flex because he's hot and I ride hot. Watson's "Questionable" doesn't move me — questionable is a label for scared GMs, he's still my best projection at that spot and he starts. Dobbins stays at RB2 over Derrick Henry again, and yeah, Henry's projected a couple points higher, I've seen the numbers — doesn't matter, trust doesn't get a fourth chance just because the math got polite about it, that's three weeks running and I'm not caving now. Tyler Loop's hurt and sitting on IR and scoring zero for me this week — I know it, you know it — but I don't own another kicker, so he starts, I eat it, and I still win anyway. Respect to Tony across the way, he builds a real roster, but respect's not the same as scared, and the Raiders defense and my offense are about to make that very clear on his scoreboard.
forum_post: Golden Child, printed in ink, and I didn't even have to ask twice — some of you are still catching up to that. Tony, I like you, you run angry backs the right way, genuine respect — and I'm still taking this one, because respect buys you a nice sentence in my post, not a win. Patricia, enjoy the countdown on offer number two, it's worse, I told you it would be. Henry's STILL benched, Dobbins STILL starts, write that down if it helps, it won't change anything. Spent my whole FAAB budget down to zero dollars this season and I'd do it again tomorrow — leaving money on the table is for people who need a safety net. See everybody Sunday.
